build_fermi_net: build a Fermi Net neural network with nspins, charges, hidden dims, and an envelope function
create_ferminet_features: create a feature layer for the Fermi Net using make_ferminet_features with natoms, nspins, and ndim
test_construct_input_features: test construct_input_features to compute electron-electron distances and verify gradient masking for diagonal terms
test_construct_symmetric_features: test construct_symmetric_features to verify electron permutation symmetry of one-body and two-body hidden features
test_antisymmetry: test Fermi Net antisymmetry by swapping electron positions and spins and verifying sign flip of the wavefunction
